title: Pricing
content:
SERVICES & PRICING

Clear Starting Prices. Solutions Built Around Your Goals.

Explore clear starting prices for professional website development, Shopify and WooCommerce stores, website redesigns and custom digital solutions. Every project is quoted based on your goals, requirements and the work involved.

Explore Packages
Request a Quote

Business-first thinking



Responsive development



Clear project communication



Built around your goals



STARTING-PRICE PACKAGES

Website & Digital Solutions Pricing.

Four service categories, transparent minimum prices and room to tailor the scope. The final quotation depends on your requirements.

BUSINESS WEBSITE

Business Website Development

For service businesses seeking a professional website that clearly presents their offer and encourages enquiries.

STARTING FROM

£450

Discuss Your Project

SCOPE CONSIDERATIONS

  • 
    Site structure and design direction
  • 
    Responsive page experience
  • 
    Contact and lead generation planning
  • 
    Content and SEO foundations

Illustrative scope considerations; not guaranteed inclusions at this starting price.

ONLINE STORE

E-commerce Development

For Shopify or WooCommerce projects requiring a practical, customer-focused store experience.

STARTING FROM

£250

Discuss Your Project

SCOPE CONSIDERATIONS

  • 
    Shopify or WooCommerce requirements
  • 
    Product and collection presentation
  • 
    Cart, checkout and payment planning
  • 
    Shipping and store operations

Illustrative scope considerations; not guaranteed inclusions at this starting price.

EXISTING WEBSITE

Website Redesign

For established websites that need a more polished design and clearer visitor journeys.

STARTING FROM

£400

Discuss Your Project

SCOPE CONSIDERATIONS

  • 
    Existing website review
  • 
    Visual and responsive improvements
  • 
    Navigation and calls to action
  • 
    Content preservation and migration review

Illustrative scope considerations; not guaranteed inclusions at this starting price.

CUSTOM SYSTEMS

Digital Solutions & Automation

For tailored integrations and workflows that reduce manual tasks and support business operations.

STARTING FROM

£700

Discuss Your Project

SCOPE CONSIDERATIONS

  • 
    Workflow and requirements review
  • 
    Integration and automation planning
  • 
    Custom functionality scoping
  • 
    Testing and handover planning

Illustrative scope considerations; not guaranteed inclusions at this starting price.

NOT SURE WHICH SERVICE FITS?

Let’s find the right approach.

Tell me what you want to build, your current challenges and your priorities. I’ll help define a suitable scope before providing a quote.

Request a Quote

NEED SOMETHING DIFFERENT?

Additional services

Website maintenance, integrations, technical improvements and other project requirements can be discussed separately.

Book a Strategy Call

All amounts shown in GBP (£). Starting prices are indicative. Final pricing, deliverables and timelines are confirmed in a written project quotation.

SCOPE BEFORE COMMITMENT

Know Exactly What Your Project Includes.

Before development begins, your proposal outlines the agreed project scope, deliverables, milestones and requirements. Whether you're planning a business website, online store or custom digital solution, you'll understand what's included and what may require a separate quotation.

01

Defined Project Deliverables

Clearly identify the pages, features, integrations and other agreed components included in your project quotation.

02

Clear Milestones & Timelines

Establish realistic delivery stages, review points and dependencies based on your project's requirements.

03

Testing & Project Handover

Confirm the applicable responsive checks, functionality testing, final deliverables and handover arrangements.

FIND YOUR FIT

Which service matches your goal?

Not sure which service fits your project? Explore the options below, or share your business goals and requirements. We'll help identify a suitable approach based on what you're looking to achieve.

Launching a Business Website

Build a professional website that introduces your services, establishes credibility and makes it easy for potential customers to contact you.

Explore Website Development

Selling Products Online

Create or improve a Shopify or WooCommerce store with clear product presentation, intuitive navigation and a practical checkout experience.

Explore E-commerce Development

Improving an Existing Website

Refresh your website's design, structure and usability while considering the content and functionality that should be preserved.

Discuss a Website Redesign

Connecting Tools and Processes

Simplify business operations through tailored integrations, automated workflows and practical digital functionality.

Discuss a Digital Solution

HOW IT WORKS

From your enquiry to a clear quotation.

Every project begins with understanding your goals and requirements. Through a straightforward discovery process, we define the scope, discuss relevant features and prepare a quotation tailored to your project.

01 · STEP

Share your goals

Tell me about your business, the website or digital solution you need, your main objectives and any existing platforms or references.

02 · STEP

Review the requirements

I'll assess the relevant pages, features, integrations, content and project dependencies to establish a suitable scope.

03 · STEP

Receive a proposal

You will receive a tailored quotation outlining the proposed deliverables, estimated timeline, pricing and next steps.

Request Your Quote

PRICING FACTORS

What Affects Your Project Price?

Website development, e-commerce and custom digital projects vary in complexity. Your final quotation reflects the agreed scope, platform, functionality, content requirements and delivery arrangements rather than a fixed package price.

Scale and complexity

The number of pages, product categories, content structures and custom requirements involved in your project.

Platform and integrations

Your CMS or e-commerce platform, payment systems, third-party services and required integrations.

Design and content

Custom design requirements, branding assets, copywriting, imagery and the availability of existing content.

Existing website condition

The current website's structure, technical issues, legacy plugins, migration requirements and data cleanup.

Functional requirements

Booking systems, user accounts, checkout processes, automation, permissions and tailored workflows.

Delivery requirements

Project dependencies, testing needs, review stages, approvals and agreed handover arrangements.

PRICING FAQ

Frequently asked pricing questions.

Answers to common questions about estimates, deliverables and project quotations.

PROJECT GUIDANCE

Not sure what your project needs yet?

You don't need a complete project brief to get started. Whether you're planning a business website, an online store or a custom digital solution, I can help you clarify the requirements and identify a suitable next step.

PLATFORMS

TIMELINES

SUPPORT

Ask a Project Question
1. Are the displayed prices fixed?

No. The displayed prices are starting estimates rather than fixed project quotations. Business Website Development starts from £450, E-commerce Development from £250, Website Redesign from £400, and Custom Digital Solutions & Automation from £700. Final pricing depends on the agreed project scope, functionality and requirements.

2. What is included in the starting price?

The starting price indicates the minimum entry point for a service, not a guaranteed list of features. Your quotation will explain the specific pages, design work, functionality, integrations and deliverables included, based on your project requirements.

3. Can I combine services?

Yes. A project may involve multiple services, such as website development, e-commerce functionality, redesign or automation. The requirements can be reviewed together to create a coordinated project scope and quotation.

4. Can you work with my existing website?

Yes. Existing websites can be reviewed for redesign, technical improvements, new functionality or integrations. The recommended approach depends on your current platform, website condition and project goals.

5. Are hosting, domains and third-party fees included?

Hosting, domain registration, premium plugins, paid integrations and other third-party subscriptions are considered separately unless your written quotation explicitly includes them. Any applicable costs should be identified before work begins.

6. How do I get an accurate quote?

Visit the Contact page and share your project goals, preferred platform, required features and any existing website or reference links. Your requirements can then be reviewed to prepare a scope-based quotation outlining the proposed work and next steps.

EXPLORE MORE

Explore My Services & Selected Work.

Explore my website development services, review documented client projects and browse selected live websites to understand my approach before requesting a quotation.

Business Website Solutions

Discover how I design and develop professional websites and digital solutions tailored to business goals.

Explore Business Solutions

Case Studies

Explore documented client projects, including the challenges, development approaches and deliverables behind my work.

View Case Studies

Portfolio

Browse selected live websites and visual examples of projects I've designed and developed.

View Portfolio

READY TO PLAN YOUR PROJECT?

Tell me what you need. Let’s define the right scope.

Planning a business website, Shopify or WooCommerce store, redesign or custom digital solution? Tell me about your goals and requirements, and I'll help identify the right next step.

Request a Project Quote
Book a Strategy Call

Starting prices are indicative. Your final quotation will confirm the agreed scope, deliverables and project cost before work begins.

CASE STUDIES & CLIENT PROJECTS

THE CASE STUDY LIBRARY

Doug Steinman building a launch-ready author website for Samuel Edmond Stone

WordPress

Responsive Design

The final Fiverr review gave 5/5 for Communication, 5/5 for Quality and 5/5 for Value. The client’s review: “I want a price to add the trilogy page and a couple more pages for the two new books into the website you made.

CASE STUDY

Einbruchschutz Baumgaertner modernizing an 11-page security site while protecting what already worked

WordPress

Trustindex

The buyer returned after Bau-Helden and commissioned a significantly larger 11-page redesign. The client explained: “I accepted your price after seeing that the work on Bau-Helden matched what I needed. I hired you for another website.”

CASE STUDY

Bau Helden turning a direct order into a structured redesign process

A three-page German WordPress redesign that began without normal pre-sale discovery, moved through visual planning and mobile refinement, and became the design reference for the client’s next, larger engagement.

WordPress

Elementor

Responsive UX

The strongest proof is retention. The same buyer later returned with a larger website and explicitly said: “I’d like a similar style to Bau-Helden you built that as well."

View Case Study

CASE STUDY

BORN Accelerators building a bilingual launch platform around a moving campaign

A Sport, Health & Tech accelerator website built to explain a new ecosystem, support German and English audiences, route startups and investors toward the right action, and still launch while campaign priorities were changing.

WordPress

Elementor

Bilingual UX

The Fiverr review recorded 5/5 Quality, 5/5 Value and 4/5 Communication. The client described the finished result as stable and solid after a complex bilingual launch.

View Case Study

CASE STUDY

Agentur Ostwest turning an outdated agency site into a clean bilingual portfolio

A focused DE/EN WordPress redesign for a German voice-over agency: simpler structure, stronger portfolio presentation, clearer navigation and a content workflow the client could continue managing himself.

WordPress

The final Fiverr review gave 5/5 for Communication, 5/5 for Quality and 5/5 for Value. The client’s review: “Perfekte Lieferung! Vielen Dank!”

HOW I APPROACH CLIENT PROJECTS

From Business Challenges to Practical Digital Solutions.

Every client project begins with understanding the business, its audience and the problem that needs solving. From website planning and design to development and delivery, I focus on practical solutions that align with the project's requirements and long-term goals.

01 · DISCOVER

Understand the Challenge

Explore the client's business, target audience, existing digital presence, priorities and project constraints.

02 · BUILD

Plan & Develop the Solution

Define the website structure, user experience, platform and required functionality before implementing the agreed solution.

03 · DELIVER

Test, Launch & Handover

Review responsive layouts, navigation and agreed functionality, then prepare the project for launch and provide the appropriate handover.

CASE STUDY QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Website Projects.

Straightforward answers about the case studies, project evidence and how to enquire about a similar solution.

PROJECT GUIDANCE

Not sure what your project needs yet?

You don't need to have every technical detail figured out. Whether you've seen a project similar to your idea or need a different solution, I can help you clarify your goals, requirements and the most suitable next step.

PLATFORMS

TIMELINES

SUPPORT

Ask a Project Question
What is a website development case study?

A website development case study explains a completed project's context, the client's challenge, the solution developed, the technologies used and the documented outcomes. It helps you understand the decisions behind the finished website, rather than only seeing screenshots.

2. What is the difference between Case Studies and Portfolio?

The Case Studies page provides detailed project explanations, including requirements, development approaches and results that can be verified. The Portfolio page offers a quicker visual overview of completed websites, with links to available live projects.

3. What types of projects are covered?

The featured work includes business website development, WordPress websites, website redesigns, product websites and other digital solutions. Individual case studies explain the specific services and functionality involved in each project.

4. Can you build a website similar to one shown here?

Yes, we can discuss a project with similar features or business objectives. Rather than copying another website exactly, I would recommend a solution tailored to your brand, target audience, content and required functionality.

5. Do all projects include measurable results?

Not always. Some projects have verifiable performance measurements, while others document completed deliverables, implemented features and improvements to the website structure or experience. I distinguish confirmed outcomes from objectives and avoid presenting estimates as proven results.

6. How do I discuss my own website project?

The technologies vary by project and may include WordPress, Divi, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify or other appropriate tools. Each detailed case study should identify the platforms and functionality actually used in that project.

7. How can I discuss a website project similar to these examples?

You can use the Contact page to share your business goals, existing website, required features and preferred timeline, or book a strategy call. I'll review the information and discuss possible next steps.

title: Contact
content:
LET'S BUILD SOMETHING MEANINGFUL

Have a Website or Digital Project in Mind? Let's Talk.

Whether you need a professional business website, an online store, a redesign or a custom digital solution, tell me what you're planning. I'll help you explore a practical approach based on your goals.

Learn More About Me
Book a Strategy Call

Business-first thinking



Responsive development



Clear project communication



Built around your goals



PROJECT DETAILS

PROJECT ENQUIRY

Tell Me About Your Project.

Share a few details about your website or digital project, including the services you need, your goals and any preferred timeline. I'll review your enquiry and discuss the most suitable next steps with you.

Please avoid including passwords, private access links, or sensitive customer information in this form.

You can also book a call if you would rather discuss the project live.

Book a Strategy Call

DIRECT CONTACT & PROFESSIONAL PROFILES

Choose How You’d Like to Connect.

Connect with Oderinde Stephen Web & Digital Solutions for business website development, WordPress projects, e-commerce, website redesigns and custom digital solutions. Choose the contact method that works best for you, or explore my professional profiles.



Email Your Project Brief

Share your goals, current website and the features you need. Email is ideal for a detailed brief.

Contact@oderindestephen.com


Call or Contact Directly

Prefer to discuss the next step directly? Use the business contact number.

+44 7848 149224


Book a Strategy Call

Arrange a project conversation using the online calendar.

Open Book a Strategy Call


LinkedIn

Connect with Stephen and review professional insights.

Open LinkedIn


Google Business Profile

Find Oderinde Stephen Web & Digital Solutions on Google, including business information and its listed location in London, United Kingdom.

Open Google Business Profile


Upwork Profile

Explore my freelance services, project experience and professional profile on Upwork

Start a Conversation on Upwork


Fiverr Profile

Explore my website development services, client feedback and available packages on Fiverr.

Start a Conversation on Fiverr

AFTER YOU REACH OUT

What Happens After You Contact Me?

Once you submit your enquiry, I'll review your project details, clarify any questions and discuss the most suitable next steps. Here's what you can generally expect when starting a website or digital development project.

01 · SHARE

Share Your Project

Tell me about your business, project goals, required features and any existing website.

02 · DISCUSS

Review & Discuss

I'll review your requirements and clarify the scope, priorities and possible solutions.

03 · PLAN

Agree on Next Steps

We'll discuss the proposed approach, deliverables and timeline before moving forward.

CONTACT QUESTIONS

Questions Before Getting Started?

Find answers to common questions about project enquiries, website development, timelines and working together before you get in touch.

PROJECT GUIDANCE

Not sure what your project needs yet?

You don't need a complete project brief to get started. Whether you're planning a business website, an online store or a custom digital solution, I can help you clarify the requirements and identify a suitable next step.

PLATFORMS

TIMELINES

SUPPORT

Ask a Project Question
1. Can I contact you before I have a full project brief?

Yes. A summary of your business, goals and current challenges is enough to begin a conversation.

2. Do you work with businesses outside your country?

Yes. I work with remote clients and can discuss requirements online across different markets.

3. Can you improve an existing website instead of building a new one?

Depending on the existing website and your goals, a redesign or targeted improvements may be more suitable than a full rebuild.

4. What should I include in my initial enquiry?

Tell me the type of website or solution you need, your key goals, useful reference links, and any timeline or budget considerations.

5. How much does a professional website or digital project cost?

Project costs depend on the number of pages, design requirements, features, integrations and technical complexity. After reviewing your project details, I can provide a quotation based on the agreed scope and deliverables.

6. How long does it take to develop a website?

Development timelines vary depending on the project size, functionality, content readiness and revision requirements. A straightforward business website generally takes less time than a complex e-commerce store or custom digital system. I'll discuss a realistic timeline after reviewing your requirements.

7. Which website platforms and technologies do you work with?

I work with WordPress, Elementor, Divi, WooCommerce, Shopify, Wix Studio and other suitable website platforms and tools. The recommended technology depends on your business goals, content management needs, required features and long-term plans.

EXPLORE RELATED SERVICES

Find the Right Digital Solution.

Explore my services to understand the options available for your website or digital project.

Business Website Solutions
Business Website Development
E-commerce Development

WORKING TOGETHER ACROSS REGIONS

Professional Website Development for Businesses Worldwide.

Oderinde Stephen Web & Digital Solutions provides website development, e-commerce solutions, website redesigns and digital services for businesses in the United Kingdom, Europe, the United States, Canada, Australia and beyond. Based in London, the business collaborates remotely with clients to plan, develop and deliver digital projects tailored to their goals.

How can I contact Oderinde Stephen Web & Digital Solutions?

Email Contact@oderindestephen.com, phone +44 7848 149224, submit the website project enquiry form, or book a strategy call at cal.com/oderinde/free.

Do you support international and remote website projects?

Yes. Project discussions and collaboration can take place remotely. The agreed communication methods, milestones and delivery dates depend on the individual project.

EXPLORE SERVICES & SELECTED WORK

Explore the Right Solution Before You Enquire.

Not sure what your project needs? Review my services and project examples to understand the options before submitting an enquiry.

Homepage

Explore the wider web development, e-commerce and digital automation offering.

Explore Homepage

Business Website Solutions

Compare approaches to improving a business website and digital presence.

Explore Business Website Solutions

Business Website Development

Understand professional business website planning, design and development.

Explore Business Website Development

E-commerce Development

Explore online store design, product experiences and commerce functionality.

Explore E-commerce Development

Case Studies

Read documented website and digital solution project stories.

Explore Case Studies

Portfolio

Browse completed websites and visit live examples.

Explore Portfolio

LET’S DISCUSS YOUR NEXT PROJECT

Ready to Turn Your Project Idea Into Reality?

Whether you're planning a business website, an e-commerce store or a custom digital solution, let's discuss your goals and explore the right approach. Share your project details or book a strategy call to get started.

Start Your Project
Book a Strategy Call

title: Business Website Development
content:
BUSINESS WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT

Professional Business Websites Built to Attract Clients.

I design and develop professional, responsive business websites that communicate your services clearly, build customer trust and turn visitor interest into enquiries. Every website is tailored to your audience, business goals and long-term growth.

Start a Website Project
View Selected Work

Strategy-led structure



Responsive development



CMS you can manage



- Built for enquiries



BUSINESS WEBSITE CHALLENGES & SOLUTIONS

Is Your Business Website Helping You Attract and Convert Clients?

If your website struggles to communicate your services, generate enquiries or support business growth, professional website development can help create a clearer, more effective customer experience.

01

WEBSITE MESSAGING & CLARITY

Visitors Don't Understand Your Services

Unclear messaging and poorly organized website content make it difficult for potential customers to understand what your business offers and why they should choose you.

Website usability

02

LEAD GENERATION & CONVERSION

Your Website Isn't Generating Enough Enquiries

A visually attractive website may still struggle to generate leads when its calls to action, trust signals and customer journey aren't aligned with visitor needs.

Conversion rate

03

WEBSITE MANAGEMENT & SCALABILITY

Visitors Don't Understand Your Services

An inflexible content management system can make updating pages, publishing content and adding new services unnecessarily complicated as your business grows.

Website development

04

USER EXPERIENCE & BUSINESS GROWTH

A Website Built to Inform, Build Trust and Convert

A well-structured business website combines clear messaging, intuitive navigation, responsive design and effective conversion paths to support customer enquiries and long-term growth.

Business website

A professional website is one part of a successful digital presence. I also build connected digital solutions that help businesses attract customers, streamline operations and support long-term growth.

Explore My Digital Solutions

SELECTED BUSINESS WEBSITE PROJECTS

Real Business Website Projects Built for Different Business Goals.

Explore selected business website development projects across different industries. Each example highlights how website structure, professional design and tailored functionality can support a business's specific needs.

Pipe Patch Pro WordPress Product Website Development

A WordPress product website featuring three pipe-repair kits, Amazon purchase links and WooCommerce infrastructure.

View Selected Work

Doug Steinman building a launch-ready author website for Samuel Edmond Stone

Doug needed help creating an online presence for the Samuel Edmondstone / Homeless Trilogy project. The work started around improving the website experience and later expanded into helping establish supporting social media presence.

View Selected Work

Einbruchschutz Baumgaertner modernizing an 11-page security site while protecting what already worked

A larger repeat-client WordPress engagement covering visual redesign, responsive rebuilding, on-page SEO, video, manufacturer proof, Google reviews, staging and production migration for a German security business.

View Selected Work
View Full Portfolio

WHAT YOUR BUSINESS WEBSITE INCLUDES

What Goes Into a Professional Business Website That Works?

A successful business website needs more than an attractive design. I combine clear service messaging, SEO-friendly content structure, conversion-focused user journeys and a manageable content management system to create websites that support your business goals.

01 · WEBSITE MESSAGING & POSITIONING

Communicate Your Services Clearly

Clear headlines, service descriptions and calls to action help potential customers understand what your business offers, who you serve and why they should choose you.

02 · SEO & WEBSITE CONTENT STRUCTURE

Organize Content for Search and Discovery

A logical sitemap, well-structured service pages, clear headings and contextual internal links help visitors and search engines understand your website.

03 · LEAD GENERATION & CONVERSION

Guide Visitors Toward Enquiries

Strategically placed contact forms, booking options and calls to action make it easier for interested visitors to take the next step.

04 · CMS & WEBSITE SCALABILITY

Keep Your Website Easy to Manage

A flexible content management system, reusable layouts and organized page templates make it easier to update content, publish new pages and expand your website.

Looking for a broader approach to your online presence? Explore my Business Website Solutions to see how website development, redesign and supporting digital functionality can work together around your business goals.

Explore Business Website Solutions

CLIENT FEEDBACK & WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT REVIEWS

What Clients Say About Working With Me.

Discover client experiences with my website design and development services, from initial planning and communication to the finished website. These reviews highlight the importance of collaboration, attention to detail and solutions tailored to real business needs.

Business Website Development

“

Stephen understood that we needed more than just an attractive website. He focused on presenting our services clearly, improving the website structure and creating a professional experience for our customers. His attention to detail and understanding of our business requirements made the entire process worthwhile.

Website Redesign & User Experience

“

Working with Stephen was a smooth and well-organized experience. He took the time to understand our goals and transformed our existing website into a cleaner, more modern and easier-to-navigate platform. We particularly appreciated his communication, thoughtful design decisions and commitment to delivering a website that reflects our business.

WordPress & CMS Development

“

Stephen brought together professional design and practical website functionality. He created a well-structured website with a flexible content management system, making it easier for our team to manage pages and update information. His technical knowledge, responsiveness and attention to our requirements were valuable throughout the project.

G2

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

Trustpilot

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

Google

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

Clutch

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

FROM VISITOR TO ENQUIRY

How a Business Website Turns Visitors into Potential Clients.

A conversion focused website guides visitors through four important stages: understanding your services, building trust, evaluating their options and taking action.

01

CLEAR WEBSITE MESSAGING

Help Visitors Understand Your Services

Explain what your business offers, who you help and why your services matter through clear, well-organized website content.

02

TRUST & CREDIBILITY

Build Confidence in Your Business

Use genuine testimonials, relevant case studies, service information and professional design to help visitors evaluate your credibility.

03

CUSTOMER DECISION JOURNEY

Make Comparing Options Easier

Provide service details, helpful FAQs, transparent information and examples that support informed buying decisions.

04

LEAD GENERATION & ACTION

Make Enquiries and Bookings Simple

Guide interested visitors toward a clear next step using accessible contact forms, booking options and relevant calls to action.

BUSINESS WEBSITE PAGES & STRUCTURE

Essential Business Website Pages and What Each One Should Achieve.

A well-structured business website helps potential customers find the information they need, understand your services and take action. Depending on your business goals, your website may include these six core page types, each serving a specific purpose in the customer journey.

01

HOMEPAGE DESIGN

Homepage

Introduce your business, communicate your main value proposition and guide visitors toward your most important services or next steps.

02

SERVICE PAGE DEVELOPMENT

Service Pages

Explain individual services, customer benefits, relevant proof and clear calls to action so visitors can evaluate the right solution.

03

ABOUT & CREDIBILITY

About & Trust

Present your business story, expertise, team, credentials and genuine testimonials to help potential customers build confidence.

02

PORTFOLIO & CASE STUDIES

Case Studies

Show real projects, business challenges, delivered solutions and verified outcomes that demonstrate your experience.

02

SEO CONTENT & RESOURCES

Insights & Resources

Publish useful articles, practical guides and answers to common customer questions that support organic discovery.

02

CONTACT & LEAD GENERATION

Contact & Booking

Make it straightforward for visitors to ask questions, request quotations or schedule consultations through accessible contact options.

Every business website is tailored to its goals.

Not every business needs the same pages. I recommend a website structure based on your services, target audience, content requirements and the actions you want visitors to take.

WEBSITE PLATFORMS & CMS SOLUTIONS

The Right Website Platform for Your Business Goals.

I build professional business websites using WordPress, Wix Studio, Squarespace, Framer and modern page builders such as Elementor and Divi. The right platform depends on your content requirements, design flexibility, budget, integrations and long-term plans.

WordPress

Ideal for growing businesses that need customizable pages, SEO-friendly content, advanced integrations and long-term flexibility.

BEST SUITED FOR

Content-rich and scalable websites

Explore This Platform

Wix Studio

Suitable for businesses that want a professionally designed website with built-in hosting, visual editing and streamlined maintenance.

BEST SUITED FOR

Managed, design-led websites

Explore This Platform

Squarespace

A practical choice for service businesses that prefer elegant templates, integrated features and straightforward content updates.

BEST SUITED FOR

Small business and service websites

Explore This Platform

Framer

Well suited to visually distinctive websites, modern layouts and interactive experiences with relatively straightforward content requirements.

BEST SUITED FOR

Design-focused business websites

Explore This Platform

Elementor

A WordPress page builder that supports flexible layouts, reusable templates and visual content editing without rebuilding pages from scratch.

BEST SUITED FOR

Custom WordPress website layouts

Explore This Platform

Divi

A visual WordPress builder for creating consistent page layouts, reusable components and manageable website design systems.

BEST SUITED FOR

Branded WordPress websites

Explore This Platform

Not sure which website platform fits your business? Explore my Business Website Solutions for a broader view of the approaches available, or contact me to discuss your requirements.

Compare Business Website Solutions

BUSINESS WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT PROCESS

My Business Website Development Process, From Planning to Launch.

Every successful business website starts with a clear plan. My development process combines business discovery, website strategy, responsive design, technical implementation and testing to create a professional website tailored to your goals.

01

Discovery & Business Goals

We discuss your business, target audience, services and current website challenges. This helps identify what your new website needs to achieve and which features matter most.

CLEAR PROJECT DIRECTION

02

Website Strategy & Structure

I plan your website pages, content hierarchy, navigation, calls to action and platform requirements to create a clear foundation for design and development.

STRATEGIC WEBSITE PLAN

03

Design & Development

I create responsive page layouts and build your website with clear messaging, consistent branding, accessible navigation and the agreed functionality.

FUNCTIONAL BUSINESS WEBSITE

04

Testing, Launch & Handover

I review the website across screen sizes, test key forms and navigation, complete agreed launch checks and provide guidance for managing your website.

LONG-TERM VALUE

BUSINESS WEBSITE INSIGHTS & RESOURCES

Expert Business Website Guides to Help You Plan, Build and Grow.

Use your Insights content to answer the questions clients often have before starting a website project.

WEBSITE CONVERSION STRATEGY

What Makes a Business Website Generate Qualified Enquiries?

Learn how service messaging, trust signals, navigation and effective calls to action help turn website visitors into potential customers.

Read the Guide

SEO & WEBSITE ARCHITECTURE

How Internal Linking Improves Business Website Structure

Understand how connecting service pages, case studies, helpful articles and contact pages makes your website easier to explore.

Read the Guide

WEBSITE CONTENT PLANNING

What Content Should a Professional Business Website Include?

Discover the essential pages, service information, credibility elements and contact options to prepare before website development.

Read the Guide

TRANSPARENT STARTING PRICES

Planning a Project? Explore My Pricing.

Explore my starting prices for business websites, Shopify and WooCommerce stores, website redesigns and custom digital solutions. Compare the options, then contact me for a quotation based on your project requirements.

Business Websites from £450 · E-commerce from £250 · Redesigns from £400 · Digital Solutions from £700

Discuss My Project
View Starting Prices

BUSINESS WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions About Business Website Development.

If your question is specific to your business, the quickest route is to discuss the goal before you commit to a platform or scope.

WEBSITE PROJECT CONSULTATION

Not Sure What Your Business Website Needs?

Whether you're starting from scratch or improving an existing website, I can help you clarify the pages, functionality, platform and development approach that best suit your business.

PLATFORMS

TIMELINES

FEATURES

Ask About Your Website Project
1. How much does a professional business website cost?

The cost of a professional business website depends on the number of pages, design requirements, content, integrations and functionality involved. A straightforward service website generally requires less development work than a more customized website with advanced features. I provide a tailored quotation after reviewing your business goals and project requirements.

2. How long does it take to develop a business website?

The timeline depends on the project's size, content readiness, design complexity and required functionality. A smaller business website may take a few weeks, while larger or more customized projects can take longer. I outline the expected milestones and delivery schedule before development begins.

3. Which platform is best for my business website?

WordPress is often a strong option for businesses that need flexible content management and room to expand. Wix Studio, Squarespace or Framer may be suitable for other requirements. I recommend a platform based on your business goals, editing preferences, budget and long-term needs rather than choosing one system for every project.

4. Will my business website be mobile-friendly and SEO-ready?

Yes, responsive layouts and foundational on-page SEO considerations are part of the website planning and development approach. These can include clear page structure, descriptive headings, internal links and mobile usability. Specific SEO deliverables are agreed during project scoping, and no website can guarantee particular search rankings.

5. Can you redesign my existing website without rebuilding everything?

Yes. Depending on the condition of your current website, I can improve its layout, navigation, messaging, responsiveness or selected pages without necessarily replacing the entire system. If the existing setup has major technical limitations, I may recommend a more comprehensive rebuild.

6. Will I be able to update my website after launch?

Yes, when your project includes an editable CMS, you can manage content such as text, images and pages according to the platform's capabilities and your assigned permissions. I can also provide handover guidance, while ongoing maintenance or additional support can be discussed separately.

title: Business Website Solutions
content:
SOLUTIONS FOR BUSINESS PROBLEMS

Start with what your business needs the website to solve.

Whether you need a new website, a better online store, a strategic redesign or a more connected client system, start with the business problem. I will help you identify the right type of website system, then choose the technology that supports it.

Find the Right Solution
Not Sure? Discuss Your Goal

Business-first strategy



Platform-flexible builds



Structured client experience



Built for long-term growth



FIND THE RIGHT ROUTE

Which situation sounds most like yours?

Start with the problem you recognise. Each route takes you to a focused page explaining the right solution in more detail.

01

I need a professional website for my business.

You need a website that explains the business clearly, builds credibility and creates a reliable path to enquiry.

BEST FIT - BUSINESS WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT

Explore Business Website Development

02

I want to sell products or services online.

You need an e-commerce system built around product discovery, buying decisions, checkout, payments and order operations.

BEST FIT - E-COMMERCE DEVELOPMENT

Explore E-commerce Development

03

I already have a website, but it is not working well.

Your current site may look outdated, communicate the wrong message, perform poorly or make it difficult for visitors to take action.

BEST FIT - WEBSITE REDESIGN

Explore Website Redesign

04

I need clients, members or students to do more online.

You may need a client portal, membership area, learning system, onboarding workflow or connected business workspace.

BEST FIT - CLIENT PORTALS & BUSINESS SYSTEMS

Explore Client Systems

NOT SURE YET?

Not sure which solution fits your business?

That is exactly what the first conversation is for. We can clarify whether you need a redesign or rebuild, what the website must do, which platform is appropriate and which integrations are actually necessary.

Discuss My Project

A strategy conversation can help clarify:

  • 
    Redesign vs. a completely new website
  • 
    Business website vs. e-commerce system
  • 
    WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify or another platform
  • 
    Which integrations are useful - and which are unnecessary
  • 
    Which integrations are useful - and which are unnecessary

PLATFORMS I BUILD WITH

Technology comes after the business need is clear.

WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify and other platforms are selected around the project, not forced onto it. The goal is the right foundation for the business now and later.

ALREADY KNOW YOUR PLATFORM?

Go directly to the platform-specific service.

If you already know the technology you need, these pages explain the platform specific development approach.

WordPress Development

Flexible, content led and customised business websites that need room to grow.

Explore This Platform

WooCommerce Development

WordPress based stores that need flexible catalogue, checkout and business integrations.

Explore This Platform

Shopify Development

Dedicated commerce builds for businesses that want a managed store platform and streamlined operations.

Explore This Platform

SELECTED WORK - REAL PROJECTS

See how digital solutions become real business results.

Explore selected website, e-commerce and redesign projects built around real business goals. Each project shows the strategy, design decisions and digital systems created to help businesses improve their online presence.

Pipe Patch Pro WordPress Product Website Development

A WordPress product website featuring three pipe-repair kits, Amazon purchase links and WooCommerce infrastructure.

View Selected Work

Doug Steinman building a launch-ready author website for Samuel Edmond Stone

Doug needed help creating an online presence for the Samuel Edmondstone / Homeless Trilogy project. The work started around improving the website experience and later expanded into helping establish supporting social media presence.

View Selected Work

Einbruchschutz Baumgaertner modernizing an 11-page security site while protecting what already worked

A larger repeat-client WordPress engagement covering visual redesign, responsive rebuilding, on-page SEO, video, manufacturer proof, Google reviews, staging and production migration for a German security business.

View Selected Work
View Full Portfolio

CLIENT FEEDBACK

Trusted by businesses building their next digital step.

Every project is a collaboration between business goals, design decisions and technical solutions. Here are some experiences from clients I have worked with across website development, redesign and digital systems projects.

Website Development

“

Stephen understood that we needed more than just a website. He focused on the structure, user experience and the message we wanted visitors to understand. The final result feels professional, clear and built around our business goals.

BUSINESS WEBSITE

“

The redesign process was smooth and well organised. Stephen improved the layout, visual direction and overall usability while keeping the focus on helping our customers find the right information faster.

WordPress / E-commerce Development

“

Stephen combined design and development in a way that made the website easier to manage and ready for future improvements. The communication was excellent throughout the project.

G2

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

Trustpilot

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

Google

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

Clutch

★★★★★ Rating · Reviews

HOW WE MOVE FORWARD

From business problem to the right website system.

A clear process keeps the project focused on the business outcome instead of getting lost in tools and features.

01

Clarify the problem

Understand the business goal and what is currently getting in the way.

CLEAR DIRECTION

02

Define the right system

Choose the website type, structure, platform and required integrations.

RIGHT FOUNDATION

03

Design and build

Create the experience around the customer journey and the business objective.

WORKING SYSTEM

04

Launch and improve

Release, measure and strengthen the website as the business grows.

LONG-TERM VALUE

TRANSPARENT STARTING PRICES

Planning a Project? Explore My Pricing.

Explore my starting prices for business websites, Shopify and WooCommerce stores, website redesigns and custom digital solutions. Compare the options, then contact me for a quotation based on your project requirements.

Business Websites from £450 · E-commerce from £250 · Redesigns from £400 · Digital Solutions from £700

Discuss My Project
View Starting Prices

COMMON DECISION QUESTIONS

Questions that help you choose the right direction.

If your question is specific to your business, the quickest route is to discuss the goal before you commit to a platform or scope.

CONTENT STRUCTURE

Not sure what your project needs yet?

That is normal. The first conversation is used to clarify the business goal, the website requirements and the most suitable next step.

PLATFORMS

TIMELINES

SUPPORT

Ask a Project Question
1. Do I need a new website or a redesign?

A redesign is usually appropriate when the existing website foundation can still support the business but the message, structure, visual experience or customer journey needs improvement. A new build makes more sense when the current system cannot support the required functionality or long-term direction.

2. Should I choose WordPress or Shopify?

WordPress is often a strong fit for flexible, content-led business websites and WooCommerce stores, while Shopify is designed specifically around managed e-commerce. The right choice depends on your business model, catalogue, integrations, team and long-term requirements.

3. Can you improve my existing website instead of rebuilding it?

Yes. If the existing platform and technical foundation are still suitable, the work can focus on the areas that are holding the website back rather than rebuilding everything unnecessarily.

4. What if I am not sure what platform I need?

You do not need to choose the platform before the project is understood. The business goal, required functionality, maintenance expectations and growth plans should determine the technology - not the other way around.

5. Can one project include a website, e-commerce and business integrations?

Yes. A project can combine public website pages, e-commerce, booking, CRM, email, analytics, client areas or other integrations when they genuinely support the same business objective.

NOT SURE WHICH SOLUTION YOU NEED?

Start with the problem. We can define the right system from there.

Book a strategy call to clarify what is not working, what the business needs next and the most sensible website system to build.

Book a Strategy Call
Start a Project

CLEAR SCOPE

Ask a Project Question
1. How much does a business website cost in 2026?

Business website costs depend on the number of pages, design requirements, functionality, content needs and integrations. A straightforward informational website generally costs less than a custom website with e-commerce, booking systems or complex integrations. I provide project-specific quotations based on your requirements, so you can understand the scope and investment before development begins.

2. How long does it take to build a business website?

The timeline depends on the project's size and complexity. A small website may take a few weeks, while larger websites involving custom features, e-commerce or integrations can require more time. The schedule also depends on content readiness, feedback and revisions. I establish a realistic timeline after reviewing the project requirements.

3. What is the best website platform for a small business?

There isn't one platform that suits every business. WordPress is a flexible choice for content-rich and service-based websites, Shopify is designed for e-commerce, and platforms such as Wix Studio may suit other requirements. I recommend a platform based on your goals, budget, content management needs and long-term plans.

4. What should a small business website include?

A professional small business website should clearly explain its services, establish trust and make contacting the business easy. Essential features often include responsive design, intuitive navigation, service information, clear calls to action, contact details, fast loading pages and basic SEO foundations. Additional functionality depends on the business.

5. How do I know if my website needs a redesign?

Consider a redesign if your website is difficult to navigate, performs poorly on mobile, looks outdated, loads slowly or no longer reflects your services. Low enquiry rates and confusing user journeys can also indicate problems. Before recommending a complete redesign, I assess whether targeted improvements could address the issues.

6. Do I still need a website if my business uses social media?

Social media can help businesses reach audiences, but a dedicated website gives you more control over your content, branding and customer experience. Your website can present detailed service information, support search visibility, collect enquiries and connect customers with your business without relying entirely on a social platform.

7. Can a website actually help a business generate more enquiries?

Yes, a well-planned website can create more opportunities for enquiries by explaining your offer clearly, attracting relevant visitors and making it easier to contact you. title: Why WordPress Is Still a Game Changer for Small Businesses in 2026
content:
Choosing a website platform has become more complicated.

Small businesses now have access to hosted website builders, e-commerce platforms, AI website generators and increasingly specialised tools that promise to get a business online quickly.

That variety is useful, but it can also distract from the question that actually matters:

What does the business need its website to do?

For some businesses, a straightforward hosted platform is enough. For others, Shopify may be the better choice. Some companies may eventually need something more custom.

But for a large number of small and growing businesses, WordPress continues to provide an unusually strong balance between control, flexibility, content management, scalability and cost.

That is why I still consider WordPress a serious option when planning business websites in 2026.

Not because it has been around for a long time.

Because when it is implemented properly, WordPress can become much more than a collection of web pages.

It can become part of the business system.

1. WordPress Gives Small Businesses More Ownership

One of the most important advantages of WordPress is control.

With a self-hosted WordPress website, the business is not completely tied to one website provider's ecosystem.

The website can normally be moved between hosting companies. Developers can be changed. Themes can be replaced. Functionality can be extended. Content can be exported. Integrations can be changed as the business evolves.

That matters more than it may seem when a company is just getting started.

A small business might initially need only a homepage, several service pages, an About page, a contact form and a simple blog.

Two years later, that same business may need online payments, appointment booking, customer accounts, lead-generation landing pages, email marketing integration, gated resources, an online course, a membership area, analytics dashboards or even a client portal.

A good website foundation should not force the business to start again every time its needs change.

WordPress gives businesses considerably more freedom to decide how their website evolves.

Ownership Does Not Mean Zero Responsibility

There is a trade-off.

Greater control also means someone needs to take responsibility for hosting, security, backups, updates and maintenance.

A managed platform may handle more of those things automatically.

That is why platform selection should never be based on a simple statement such as:

“WordPress is better.”

The better question is:

Does the business benefit enough from the additional control to justify managing that control properly?

For many service businesses, professional firms, content-led companies and growing organisations, the answer can be yes.

2. WordPress Can Support Different Business Models

Another reason WordPress remains useful is that it does not force every business into the same structure.

A photographer does not need the same website as an accounting firm.

A coach does not need the same system as a training company.

A local service business does not need the same customer journey as an e-commerce store.

WordPress can be adapted around the business rather than forcing the business to adapt around a rigid website model.

A WordPress website can function as a lead-generation website where service pages, landing pages, case studies, forms, testimonials and calls to action work together to turn website traffic into enquiries.

It can also serve as a content and authority platform where a business publishes articles, guides, resources and case studies that support search visibility and build trust over time.

For appointment-based businesses, WordPress can support consultations, classes and service bookings.

For companies selling online, WooCommerce can transform WordPress into an e-commerce platform with products, customer accounts, payments and order management.

It can also support memberships, learning platforms, restricted content and more advanced client systems involving onboarding, documents, project information and integrations with external business tools.

The important point is not that every WordPress website should include all of these features.

It should not.

The advantage is that the foundation gives the business options.

3. WordPress Can Still Be Budget-Friendly

“WordPress is free” is one of those statements that is technically true but practically incomplete.

The WordPress software itself is open source.

A professional WordPress website, however, still has costs.

Depending on the project, those costs may include domain registration, website hosting, premium themes, premium plugins, development, design, security, maintenance, performance optimisation, third-party integrations and ongoing support.

So the real advantage is not that WordPress costs nothing.

The advantage is that businesses have considerable flexibility over where and how their money is spent.

A small company can begin with a relatively straightforward setup and invest more as the website becomes more valuable to the business.

It does not necessarily need an expensive custom software platform from the beginning.

At the same time, the business is not limited to staying with its initial setup forever.

Think About Total Value, Not Just Launch Price

The cheapest website is not automatically the most affordable website.

Suppose one solution costs less initially but becomes difficult to expand.

If every new business requirement requires another workaround, another external platform or eventually a complete rebuild, that low initial price may become expensive.

A better calculation is:

What will this website cost to own, operate and develop over the next few years?

For many small businesses, WordPress performs well when considered from that longer-term perspective.

4. WordPress Is Still Strong for SEO and Content

A platform cannot guarantee search rankings.

Installing WordPress does not automatically make a website search-engine friendly.

Good SEO still depends on useful content, clear page structure, crawlable internal links, relevant page titles, search intent, technical quality, mobile usability, website performance and the authority the website develops over time.

But WordPress provides a very good environment for managing those elements.

That is particularly valuable for businesses where content is part of the growth strategy.

A business website might contain service pages that explain what the company offers, case studies that demonstrate evidence and experience, insights that answer questions prospective customers are already searching for, and resources that educate visitors while creating opportunities for lead generation.

Those pieces can be connected through internal links so the website becomes an organised information system rather than a collection of isolated pages.

That is a much stronger approach than publishing random blog posts simply because somebody said blogging is good for SEO.

Content should support the wider website strategy.

5. WordPress Can Grow With the Business

One of the biggest mistakes in website planning is solving only today's problem.

Of course, a small business should not overbuild.

There is no point creating a massive technical system for a company that currently needs five simple pages and a contact form.

But there should still be some thought about what could realistically happen next.

A website might begin with a simple journey:

Website → Contact Form → Email

Later, that could develop into:

Website → Qualified Enquiry Form → CRM → Email Follow-up → Booking

A content-led business might begin with:

Website → Services

and later develop into:

Website → Services → Case Studies → Resources → Lead Magnet → Email Nurturing

An online seller might begin with a simple product catalogue and later add:

WooCommerce → Online Payments → Customer Accounts → Subscription Products

A well-planned WordPress installation can develop through stages.

That is important because growth rarely happens all at once.

The website can start with the features the business genuinely needs and become more sophisticated when there is a business reason for doing so.

Scalability Is Also About Structure

Growth does not simply mean adding more plugins.

In fact, constantly adding plugins without a plan is one of the easiest ways to create a difficult WordPress website.

Scalability begins with decisions such as how content is organised, which functionality belongs inside WordPress, which functionality should come from external services, how reusable sections are built, how performance is managed and how customer data moves between systems.

It also means thinking about whether another developer could understand and maintain the website later.

The goal should be a maintainable system, not simply a website with a long plugin list.

6. WordPress Can Be Manageable for Business Owners

A website should not require a developer every time the company wants to change one sentence.

For many small businesses, this is another area where WordPress works well.

Once the website has been structured properly, the business owner or team can usually manage routine content such as blog posts, page copy, images, products, team members, case studies, FAQs and testimonials.

This becomes even more useful when the backend has been designed around the business.

For example, instead of asking a client to edit complex page layouts, a developer can create structured fields for information such as:

Case Study Title

Business Challenge

System Delivered

Verified Outcome

Technology Used

The client updates the information, while the website template controls how that information appears.

This separation between content and presentation can make WordPress significantly easier to manage.

The quality of the implementation matters enormously here.

A badly organised WordPress backend can be confusing.

A thoughtfully organised one can make day-to-day website management straightforward.

7. WordPress Works Well With Other Business Tools

Modern websites rarely operate alone.

A business may already use email marketing software, a CRM, Google Analytics, booking software, payment providers, accounting tools, customer support tools or internal business systems.

The website needs to participate in that wider environment.

WordPress has a mature integration ecosystem, making it possible to connect website actions with many other platforms.

For example, an enquiry could move through a system such as:

Visitor → Landing Page → Enquiry Form → CRM → Email Follow-up → Sales Conversation

An appointment-based business could have:

Visitor → Service Page → Booking → Calendar → Confirmation Email

An e-commerce business might use:

Product → Cart → Checkout → Payment → Order → Customer Communication

This is where conversations about websites become much more interesting.

The question changes from:

“Which page builder should we use?”

to:

“How should the business's digital customer journey work?”

That is a much more valuable discussion.

8. WordPress Has a Large and Mature Ecosystem

WordPress has been around for a long time, and that maturity creates another advantage.

There is an enormous ecosystem around it.

Businesses have access to developers, designers, hosting providers, plugins, themes, documentation, integrations, specialist agencies, freelancers, performance tools, security tools and educational resources.

That makes it easier to avoid becoming completely dependent on one developer or company.

If a business relationship changes, there are many other professionals who understand the platform.

However, the size of the ecosystem also creates one of WordPress's biggest weaknesses.

There are countless plugins and themes of very different quality.

Choosing the wrong combination can create performance problems, security risks, compatibility issues, unnecessary complexity and difficult maintenance.

The freedom WordPress provides is powerful, but it needs discipline.

More options do not automatically create a better website.

The right options need to be selected for the actual business requirement.

9. WordPress Is Not Automatically the Right Choice

WordPress should not be recommended simply because a developer happens to specialise in WordPress.

Platform recommendations should follow the business requirement.

There are situations where another platform makes more sense.

When Shopify May Be a Better Choice

If the business is primarily an online store and wants a strongly managed e-commerce environment with less responsibility for the underlying technical infrastructure, Shopify may be the more practical choice.

When Squarespace May Be Enough

A relatively simple marketing website may not need the flexibility that WordPress provides.

If the business values an all-in-one managed environment and expects limited custom functionality, Squarespace may be enough.

When Wix Studio May Make Sense

Wix Studio can work well where the project benefits from its visual environment and the business requirements fit comfortably within its ecosystem.

When a Custom Application May Be Better

Sometimes the business is actually building software rather than a conventional website.

If the core product involves complex user workflows, highly specialised dashboards or significant application logic, forcing everything into WordPress may be the wrong architectural decision.

The question is not:

“Can WordPress do it?”

With enough customisation, the answer to that question is often yes.

The more useful question is:

“Is WordPress the sensible foundation for doing it?”

Those are very different questions.

10. When WordPress Makes the Most Sense for a Small Business

WordPress deserves serious consideration when several conditions are present.

Content Is Important

The company wants to publish articles, case studies, resources or other search-focused content regularly.

The Website Will Evolve

The current version is only the beginning, and additional functionality may be required later.

Ownership Matters

The business wants greater control over hosting, development and long-term platform decisions.

Customisation Is Important

The website needs to reflect a specific customer journey rather than follow a rigid template.

Several Systems Need to Connect

Forms, CRM, email, analytics, bookings, payments or other tools need to work together.

WordPress Expertise Is Available

The business has access to someone who can build, maintain and improve the system correctly.

If those conditions exist, WordPress can remain a very strong foundation.

The Real Game Changer Is Not WordPress Itself

There is an important distinction here.

WordPress does not make a business successful.

A website platform is infrastructure.

The real value comes from what is built on top of it.

A WordPress website with unclear messaging, poor navigation and no meaningful conversion journey will still perform badly.

A beautifully designed homepage cannot fix an offer visitors do not understand.

Installing more plugins cannot fix weak strategy.

The strongest website systems usually connect several things.

Business Goal

What should the website help the company achieve?

↓

Message

Can visitors quickly understand what the business offers and who it is for?

↓

Trust

Is there enough evidence for visitors to believe the claims?

↓

Customer Journey

Is the next step obvious?

↓

Technology

Which platform and tools can support that journey reliably?

Technology belongs in that sequence.

It should not be the starting point.

A Practical WordPress Checklist for Small Businesses

Before choosing WordPress, ask yourself:

  1. What business result should the website support?
  2. Who is the primary customer?
  3. What information does that customer need before taking action?
  4. What action should they take?
  5. Will the business publish content regularly?
  6. Does the website need bookings, payments, memberships or other functionality?
  7. Which existing business tools need to connect to the website?
  8. Who will maintain the website after launch?
  9. What could realistically change over the next two or three years?
  10. Does the business value flexibility enough to take responsibility for maintaining a self-hosted platform?

Those answers tell you much more than a generic platform comparison.

So, Is WordPress Still Worth It in 2026?

For many small businesses, yes.

WordPress remains compelling because businesses do not have to choose between starting relatively simply and having room to grow.

It can support a straightforward business website today and a much more connected digital system tomorrow.

Its strongest advantages remain ownership, flexibility, content management, extensibility, integration possibilities and long-term adaptability.

But WordPress works best when it is treated as a foundation rather than a shortcut.

The objective should not simply be to build “a WordPress website.”

The objective should be to build a website system that helps the business communicate clearly, attract the right people, create trust and make it easier for customers to take the next step.

WordPress is simply one very capable way of building that system.

title: Pipe Patch Pro WordPress Product Website Development
content:


BUSINESS

Emergency Pipe Repair Kits



PLATFORM

WordPress Product Website



COMMERCE

WooCommerce



INFRASTRUCTURE

Hostinger + Business Email

FROM THE PROJECT BRIEF

An independent product website that complements Amazon — instead of depending on it.

Pipe Patch Pro needed its own web presence for product education, support and multiple purchase pathways.

BUSINESS GOAL

Build a standalone sales and support hub around three Pipe Patch Pro repair kits.

The client wanted Pipe Patch Pro separated from Amazon while still giving shoppers a direct route to the FMP 888 storefront and a WooCommerce option for direct orders.

SYSTEM DELIVERED

A WordPress Product Website with a focused landing page, product presentation sections and clear calls to action.

The build included Hostinger and WordPress setup, Homeowners, Contractors and Facilities Maintenance kit presentation, How It Works and Build Standards content, FAQ, Amazon review content, business email and WooCommerce onboarding support.

PLATFORM & COMMERCE



WordPress



WooCommerce



Hostinger

Amazon storefront links and info@pipepatchpro.net completed the product purchase and support flow.

DELIVERED OUTCOME

Standalone product platform launched

pipepatchpro.net went live with dedicated product content, Amazon purchase links and a WooCommerce foundation. Direct WooCommerce payment activation remained dependent on the client completing banking and WooPayments onboarding.

DOMAIN MIGRATION & MIGRATE + BUILD

The domain move from Wix delayed the build — but not the product plan.

pipepatchpro.net was held at Wix until transfer eligibility, then moved to Hostinger. Development also required access troubleshooting and two-factor authentication coordination before WordPress installation could move forward.

BEFORE

Amazon sales without an independent product hub



Domain locked at Wix during transfer window



No standalone WordPress product site



No central customer-support inbox



Product content split across Amazon assets



MIGRATE + BUILD

Transfer
Build
Connect

AFTER

Launch-ready WordPress Product Website



Domain transferred to Hostinger



Three kit paths structured



Amazon + WooCommerce purchase routes



Business support email created

WEBSITE ARCHITECTURE

One product story, six conversion-focused sections.

The site was organized around the questions buyers need answered before purchase: what it is, how it works, which kit fits, why it is credible, where to buy and how to get support.

PRODUCT



Domain transferred to Hostinger

HOW IT WORKS



Product overview

KITS

BUILD STANDARDS



150 PSI + 304 stainless steel

REVIEWS



Amazon customer proof

SUPPORT



FAQ + business email

PRODUCT RANGE

Three kits for three different maintenance needs.

The final website distinguishes the product by user type and repair quantity, using the client-approved kit names, pricing and use cases.

HOW IT WORKS

HOMEOWNERS

6 PACK · $16.99 · Common household pipes from 1/4" to 3/4", hot or cold water, indoors or outside.

↔

CONTRACTORS

12 PACK · $21.99 · Plumbers, handyman services and property managers · 12 repairs.

20 PACK

FACILITIES

20 PACK · $24.95 · Healthcare facilities, schools, office buildings and apartment complexes · 20 repairs.

VISUAL EVIDENCE

Product presentation designed to build confidence before purchase.

PROJECT COMMERCE

A standalone Pipe Patch Pro site that complements Amazon and supports direct sales.

The final website gave Pipe Patch Pro its own brand home, clearer product education and multiple buying paths while keeping the owner able to update images and content.

pipepatchpro.net launched on WordPress and Hostinger with three product tiers, Amazon storefront routes, WooCommerce infrastructure and a dedicated support mailbox.

CASE STUDY • WORDPRESS • BOOK LAUNCH

Doug Steinman — building a launch-ready author website for Samuel Edmond Stone.

A focused WordPress website project created to introduce Samuel Edmond Stone, present the book clearly, and establish a launch-ready online presence the client could keep expanding.

CATEGORY

Author Website Project

FROM THE PROJECT BRIEF

The client request developed into a complete author website solution.

A clear summary of the website goals, the implementation process and the delivered WordPress solution for the book project.

PROJECT GOAL

Create a professional online presence for an upcoming book project with a clear structure for readers and visitors.

Develop a dedicated landing page that introduces the author, presents the book project, supports future reader engagement and remains easy for the client to manage.

SYSTEM DELIVERED

A WordPress author website with a focused landing page, book presentation sections and clear calls to action.

WordPress setup, landing page development, author biography section, book presentation content, CTA areas, contact/newsletter capability, responsive layout and hosting configuration.

PROJECT TECHNOLOGIES



WordPress



Hosting Setup



Responsive Design

The build combined the core tools and setup needed to launch the site quickly and keep it easy to manage.

VERIFIED OUTCOME

Launch-ready author website

The final Fiverr review gave 5/5 for Communication, 5/5 for Quality and 5/5 for Value. The client’s review: “I want a price to add the trilogy page and a couple more pages for the two new books into the website you made.”

THE PROJECT CHALLENGE

The site needed to be ready before the book was fully published.

The challenge was to set up the domain, hosting and WordPress foundation early, present the author and book clearly, and keep enough flexibility for future expansion as new titles were added.

A larger repeat-client WordPress engagement covering visual redesign, responsive rebuilding, on-page SEO, video, manufacturer proof, Google reviews, staging and production migration for a German security business.

BUSINESS FOCUS

Modernize a live security-company website without discarding established brand equity.

Improve structure, mobile behaviour, trust, on-page SEO and performance while preserving the red already used across vehicles, flyers and other offline brand materials.

SYSTEM DELIVERED

An 11-page WordPress redesign combining staging, responsive rebuild, SEO, proof integrations and controlled migration.

THE REDESIGN QUESTION

What should stay — and what actually needed to change?

The project was not a blank-slate redesign. It had existing content, an established red brand, legacy tools and years of business history worth preserving.

title: Bau Helden turning a direct order into a structured redesign process
content:
CASE STUDY • WORDPRESS • DIRECT ORDER

Bau-Helden — turning a direct order into a structured redesign process.

A three-page German WordPress redesign that began without normal pre-sale discovery, moved through visual planning and mobile refinement, and became the design reference for the client’s next, larger engagement.



Construction



3 core pages



Pre-design first



Repeat client

Visit Live Website ↗
All Case Studies




bau-helden.de

REDESIGNED HOMEPAGE

PROJECT SCREENSHOT

ALT: Bau-Helden WordPress redesign showing the new construction-company homepage and responsive structure.



ORDER

Direct Fiverr order



SCOPE

3 core pages



ASSETS

6 Envato items



OUTCOME

Repeat client

FROM THE ARCHIVE CARD

The homepage summary, expanded into the full project brief.

The same core information visitors first see on the homepage card is carried into the full case study so the transition stays consistent.

BUSINESS FOCUS

Turn a direct order with limited discovery into a clear, credible construction-company website.

Create a stronger digital presentation despite WordPress access being unavailable at the start, no normal pre-sale discovery conversation, and the need to define visual direction before development.

SYSTEM DELIVERED

A three-page WordPress redesign shaped through pre-design, responsive refinement and transparent asset handoff.

Home, Career and Contact pages; pre-design/wireframe before development; responsive menu and spacing cleanup; link corrections; and source links for the six Envato Elements assets used in the project.

PROJECT TECHNOLOGIES



WordPress



Responsive UX



Pre-design

These mirror the Technology 1–3 fields used by the homepage case-study card.

VERIFIED OUTCOME

REPEAT CLIENT OUTCOME

The strongest proof is retention. The same buyer later returned with a larger website and explicitly said: “I’d like a similar style to Bau-Helden — you built that as well.”

THE STARTING POINT

The order arrived before the project had a complete design direction.

Instead of jumping straight into WordPress, the project needed a short recovery and planning sequence first.

01



DIRECT ORDER

Client committed before normal discovery.

02



ACCESS ISSUE

WordPress admin was unavailable initially.

03



PRE-DESIGN

Visual structure created before development.

04



BUILD

Three pages implemented and refined.

SITE ARCHITECTURE

Three pages, three different business jobs.

The project stayed intentionally compact. Each page had a clear role instead of adding unnecessary content.



HOME

Credibility + services

Introduce the company, establish visual trust and route visitors to the right next step.



CAREER

Recruitment path

Give potential applicants a dedicated route without cluttering the commercial homepage.



CONTACT

Enquiry path

Make it straightforward for prospects to reach the business.



Mobile navigation



Spacing cleanup



Link corrections



Asset handoff

PRE-DESIGN FIRST

A short design step prevented the direct order from becoming a blind build.

The wireframe/pre-design stage established the visual direction before WordPress implementation, making later refinement much more controlled.

WITHOUT PRE-DESIGN



More interpretation during build



Higher chance of rework



Harder mobile decisions



WIREFRAME

WITH PRE-DESIGN



Clear visual direction



Controlled implementation



Better responsive refinement

VISUAL EVIDENCE

The finished pages should carry the proof.

Use the large frame for the homepage and the supporting cards for mobile, Career and Contact.

REPEAT-CLIENT PROOF

“I’d like a similar style to Bau-Helden — you built that as well.”

This quote came from the same buyer when commissioning the next, larger website.

THE OUTCOME

A successful first engagement that directly generated the next project.

The clearest business result is retention: the client trusted the Bau-Helden design enough to use it as the reference for a larger second website.

REPEAT

CLIENT ENGAGEMENT

The first redesign created enough confidence for the buyer to return with a larger scope.

DELIVERED

Three-page WordPress redesign

Desktop + mobile refinement

Envato source links supplied

title: BORN Accelerators building a bilingual launch platform around a moving campaign
content:
CASE STUDY • WORDPRESS • BILINGUAL

BORN Accelerators — building a bilingual launch platform around a moving campaign.

A Sport, Health & Tech accelerator website built to explain a new ecosystem, support German and English audiences, route startups and investors toward the right action, and still launch while campaign priorities were changing.

FROM THE ARCHIVE CARD

The short card summary, expanded into the full project brief.

These are the same core details visitors first meet on the homepage case-study card, carried into the full project page so the story remains consistent.

BUSINESS FOCUS

Launch a credible bilingual accelerator platform without waiting for every campaign detail to stop changing.

Clarify BORN’s offer, support the ISPO campaign, guide startups and investors toward different actions, and keep the structure flexible enough to absorb evolving content and priorities.

SYSTEM DELIVERED

A bilingual WordPress + Elementor system connecting content, conversion, proof and launch operations.

DE/EN architecture, startup and investor conversion routes, reusable ecosystem sections for partners, athletes and hubs, application routing, migration to production and final stabilization.

The Fiverr review recorded 5/5 Quality, 5/5 Value and 4/5 Communication. The client described the finished result as stable and solid after a complex bilingual launch.

THE CHALLENGE

Build for a fixed launch date while the brief was still moving.

BORN’s website could not wait for every campaign detail to settle. The project needed enough structure to move forward while still being flexible enough to absorb new priorities, bilingual content and multiple audience journeys.

title: Agentur Ostwest turning an outdated agency site into a clean bilingual portfolio
content:
CASE STUDY • WORDPRESS • REDESIGN

Agentur Ostwest — turning an outdated agency site into a clean bilingual portfolio.

A focused DE/EN WordPress redesign for a German voice-over agency: simpler structure, stronger portfolio presentation, clearer navigation and a content workflow the client could continue managing himself.



Voice Agency



German + English



One-page redesign



5.0/5 review

All Case Studies




agenturostwest.de



FORMAT

One-page portfolio



LANGUAGES

German + English



REVIEW

5.0 / 5

FROM THE ARCHIVE CARD

The homepage summary, expanded into the full project brief.

The same core information visitors first see on the homepage card is carried into the full case study so the transition stays consistent.

BUSINESS FOCUS

Modernize the agency presentation without making content ownership harder.

Replace an outdated custom-theme experience with a compact bilingual portfolio that makes the agency easier to understand, easier to browse and easier for the client to maintain.

SYSTEM DELIVERED

A one-page bilingual WordPress portfolio with reusable presentation blocks and clean navigation.

Compact intro, nine portfolio tiles, production section, DE/EN navigation, contact/legal links, responsive cleanup and a workflow that allowed the client to manage final copy directly.

PROJECT TECHNOLOGIES



WordPress



Bilingual UX



Responsive UX

These mirror the Technology 1–3 fields used by the homepage case-study card.

VERIFIED OUTCOME

5.0 / 5 CLIENT REVIEW

The final Fiverr review gave 5/5 for Communication, 5/5 for Quality and 5/5 for Value. The client’s review: “Perfekte Lieferung! Vielen Dank!”

THE REDESIGN PROBLEM

The site had to feel more professional without becoming harder to own.

The redesign was less about adding more pages and more about removing friction: obsolete structure, weak portfolio presentation and unnecessary complexity.
